source.title: eFootball Reverse Engineering Community Archive — Attribute engine, spatial geometry & skill mechanics (4 slides)
source.note: Datamine of libUE4.so (ARM64, NetEase v11.0.0). Treated as fact, at the same level as the eFHUB article (user decision, 18 Oct 2026). Where both agree the engine uses the value; conflicts are listed.

stages: Condition arrow (interpolated by OVR, not a flat %)

claims.vsEngine: Used by the engine: action-local values are capped at 127 (boosters still stop at 120).
These bands are the eFHUB-measured table at proficiency 89 (at 88 eFHUB gives 40–56 +1, 57–84 +2, 85–99 +3). The engine keeps the per-proficiency eFHUB table.

claims.claim: Independent systems: in-match skill buffs do not recalculate the manager bonus.
claims.vsEngine: Same as the article (manager uses the reference value before skills).

skills.name: Super-sub
skills.hypothesis: Raises the condition arrow one tier or adds a flat +10%.
skills.finding: Flat +1 to 25 core match stats, independent of condition arrows. Stamina excluded.

skills.name: Blitz Curler
skills.hypothesis: Adds raw Curl or Finishing, clamped at 99.
skills.finding: Finesse shot at 50%+ power and ≤35 m: launch angle +3.87° / +6.77° plus topspin. Not affected by the 99 cap (no stat change).

skills.name: Momentum Dribbling
skills.hypothesis: Only inside the attacking box or final third.
skills.finding: Momentum zone past the +18 m line (18.14 m before the penalty box, box front at +36.14 m): +6 Dribbling, Tight Possession, Speed and Acceleration across the full pitch width.

skills.name: Phenomenal Finishing
skills.hypothesis: Ignores body balance or permanently buffs Finishing.
skills.finding: In awkward postures injects +7 local Finishing: a 99 player shoots with an effective 106.

skills.name: Visionary Pass
skills.hypothesis: Laser auto-assist with 100% accuracy ignoring body balance.
skills.finding: +6 local ability: tags the ball for the receiver's next action.

skills.name: Phenomenal Pass
skills.hypothesis: Laser auto-assist with 100% accuracy ignoring body balance.

skills.name: Fighting Spirit
skills.hypothesis: Inactive until the stamina bar flashes red late in the match.
skills.finding: Active all 90 min: multiplies pressure penalties by 0.8 (−20%) and delays running-exhaustion drop-offs.

skills.name: Acceleration Burst (Edge Turn)
skills.finding: +0.1 tight-control coefficient at speed < 20 and a 1.025 config multiplier (internal parameter). No stat change.

skills.name: Bullet Header
skills.hypothesis: Adds raw points to Heading or Jump.
skills.finding: Exit-velocity upper bound +4.0 km/h and tighter dispersion. Stacks with standard Heading (+5 local).

skills.name: Fortress
skills.hypothesis: Placebo or a magical goal barrier.
skills.finding: Leading in the 2nd half / extra time: flat +6 to Defensive Awareness, Tackling, Defensive Engagement and Aggression.

skills.name: Magnetic Feet
skills.finding: Scans opponents within 5 m (0 < dist < 5 m), excluding a 180° blind spot directly behind. 1 opponent +2, 2 → +4, 3 → +6, 4+ → +8 (max) to Dribbling, Tight Possession, Physical Contact and Balance. Clamped at 99: base must be ≤ 91 for the full +8.
skills.vsCommunity: Used by the engine, including the rear blind spot.

skills.name: Long-reach Tackle
skills.finding: Does not modify Tackling. Animation tolerances: angular upper bound +5.625° (wider reach) and lateral correction +3 units (rate limit). Zero stat changes.
skills.vsCommunity: Slides call it Power / Sliding Tackle; the Chinese name 伸脚抢截 is Long-reach Tackle.

skills.name: GK Directing Defence
skills.finding: GK defensive zone behind the −18 m line (covers the whole defensive third for CBs): +2 Awareness & Tackling.
skills.vsCommunity: Used by the engine (datamine wins): Defensive Awareness and Tackling. The article said Aggression.

otherSkills.name: Through Passing
otherSkills.hypothesis: Flat +5 to pass stats or auto-locks the trajectory into space.
otherSkills.finding: Hybrid model: +5 applies to random deviation, trajectory and lofted apex. The turn animation uses the base stat.
otherSkills.vsCommunity: Used by the engine as the article's ordinary passing +5 (local, through passes). The r/Amadeusz +20% is not used.
